image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a white audio cassette tape. The image shows the two circular spool hubs with visible gear teeth, the central rectangular window revealing the magnetic tape (appearing dark/black), and a paper label with orange handwritten text. The casing appears to be opaque white plastic. There are molded details around the spools and screw holes near the bottom corners.
